beforeDisplay: Identify the exact artwork, version, print state and reproduction file.
Record written artwork-rights permission or another documented, reviewed basis for the intended use.
Check the reproduction provider’s own image terms and obtain any additional required permission.
Confirm that permission covers the public website, intended audience and territories, duration, resolution, and any entrance/cover or promotional use.
Record required captions, copyright credits, cropping restrictions, fees, expiry and renewal conditions.
decision: Keep reproductions out of the site while permission remains unresolved. Attribution, low resolution, availability on a museum site, or describing the site as educational are not recorded here as permission. Do not rely on a fair-use exception for this release without case-specific review.
limits: This is an editorial clearance decision, not a legal opinion or guarantee against claims. No permission request has been sent and no licence has been purchased.
